Subject: Offer packet — delegation matrix & comp-band signoff for Jordan Ellis

Hi Laura and Tessa,

Following up from the hiring sync: Jordan Ellis (candidate) is at verbal offer stage for Sr Software Engineer (IC-4). Before I create the formal offer in Greenhouse, can you confirm the delegation/approval routing for this role and the comp band to use?

Quick facts:
- Role: Sr Software Engineer (IC-4) — JD attached.
- Proposed comp band: E3 (base 170k–200k) with target equity 0.08% and 12 weeks PTO.
- Hiring manager (Laura) indicated flexibility on base but needs approval for any escalation above midpoint.

Ask:
1) Laura — please confirm you approve base up to $185,000. If we need to go above that, who should I route to (Vivek or Monica)?
2) Tessa — can you prepare the offer in Greenhouse and include the comp-band matrix and approver notes as attachments? Use the restricted offer template for external counsel review if comp or equity deviates from policy.

I attached JD_Sr_Software_Engineer.pdf and comp_band_matrix_Q3_2027.xlsx for quick reference.

I plan to send the candidate a time-limited DocuSign offer (7-day window) once approvals are in place.

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer packet — delegation matrix & comp-band signoff for Jordan Ellis

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below.

- I approve up to $185,000 base (within E3 range).
- If we need to exceed $185k or increase equity >0.08%, route to Monica for final sign-off (I will not approve >200k).
- If comp sits at midpoint or below, local approvals (me + Talent) are sufficient; no need to escalate.

Tessa — please prepare the GH offer and flag the approver routing step. For transparency, include a one-line rationale in the GH comments (candidate unique experience w/ distributed systems and prior infra leadership).

Laura

Thanks — creating the offer in Greenhouse now. Plan below:

1) Create offer in GH (use offer template: offer_template_restricted.docx).
2) Set comp line: Base $183,000, OTE N/A, Sign-on = $10,000 (prorated), Equity 0.08% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff).
3) Add attachments: JD_Sr_Software_Engineer.pdf, comp_band_matrix_Q3_2027.xlsx.
4) Set approval flow in GH: Laura -> Marissa -> Monica (auto-escalate to Monica if approver passes >$185k or equity >0.08%).
5) Add approver note with short rationale (distributed systems + IC mentoring).
6) Draft DocuSign envelope (7-day acceptance window) but hold until approvals complete; I will request legal review only if comp or equity exceeds policy.

I will tag both of you in the GH activity and drop the offer preview link here once created. If anyone wants a different sign-on or PTO language, tell me now.

—Tessa
